claims: The Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team has won two NCAA Division I National Championships.
The Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team's latest title occurred in 2026, defeating UConn 69-63.
The Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team's 2026 championship win broke a 37-year drought since their first title in 1989.
The Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team has made eight Final Four appearances.
In 2026, under coach Dusty May, Michigan defeated UConn 69-63 on April 6, 2026, in Indianapolis.
The 2026 championship team featured an all-transfer starting lineup.
In 1989, Michigan won its first title by defeating Seton Hall 80-79 in overtime.
The 2026 championship team won by a total margin of +114 throughout the tournament
